exposure: Pulsatility and resistance indices in the middle cerebral artery
Pulsatility and resistance indices in the umbilical artery
cohort: The study included 148 women with uncomplicated pregnancies between 40 and 42 completed weeks of gestation, divided into groups with and without a fetal brain-sparing effect.
finding: The cerebroplacental ratio (C/U) index showed the highest sensitivity in predicting both intrapartum fetal heart rate abnormalities and adverse neonatal outcomes in uncomplicated pregnancies at 40 weeks and beyond.
cross-section timing: Between 40 and 42 completed weeks of gestation (for exposure assessment)
